fact: The KSEIP 2 environmental and social management plan says all four National Safety Net Programme cash transfers (HSNP, OPCT, CT-OVC, PwSD-CT) use the Enhanced Single Registry, a national database of poor and vulnerable households, for targeting (except OPCT), transfers and management information systems.

The plan says the National Safety Net Programme programmes use the Enhanced Single Registry for electronic transfers to bank accounts and mobile money, alongside secure management information systems.

Kenyans.co.ke reported that the State Department for Social Protection and Senior Citizen Affairs invited consultants to upgrade the Enhanced Single Registry and the Community Development Management Information System so they exchange data with SHA, NSSF, IPRS, the National Registration Bureau, Civil Registration Services and cash transfer programmes, under the World Bank-funded KSEIP-2; the assignment is an individual consultancy still being procured.
system: Enhanced Single Registry (ESR) and Community Development Management Information System (CDMIS)

fact: Social Protection Act 2025 (s.40) requires the National Board for Social Protection to establish a Social Protection Registry as the singular database for social protection interventions under the Act, used to select and register beneficiaries and coordinate interventions; the Act also requires the Registry to be updated in real time through interoperability with other national registries (s.40(4)(c)) and the Board to facilitate data sharing and interoperability among social protection information systems (s.8(g)).

Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale said the national government sponsors 558,000 indigent households under the Social Health Authority, identified through the State Department for Social Protection's Enhanced Single Registry.
